ai_summary: The APK ships exactly one on-device model, assets/model (680,154 B, sha256 b282b4ef...2a9f15), which is not a TFLite/SNPE/MACE file but a custom big-endian binary containing a 5-stage cascade of log-linear SMS spam/phishing classifiers: 68/23/10/10/16 features per stage, 8000/8000/5752/4759/2573 token weights, 414/292/193/139/171 substring-pattern weights, per-stage character dictionaries, a message-length feature, 9 rule features and an 8-way sender-category bias table, followed by three decision thresholds. It is loaded by ah.c.b(Context,"model") from ah.d.h and evaluated against a normalised SMS (ah.b) whose tokens come from the assets/dict word segmenter. A second, newer SMS engine (d9.a -> a9.a/a9.c) uses the bundled TensorFlow Lite 2.8.4 JNI library, but its models (1.bin, 2.bin) and vocabulary (v.txt) are downloaded in resource.zip and are not in the APK. Game Turbo 'AI' features (AI subtitles, UltraClear, video-call beauty/privacy/portrait/pickup) are UI + allow-list configuration only; inference is delegated to com.xiaomi.aiasst.vision and vendor camera/video-toolbox code, and assets/redmi_performance_mode/Ai-Model.json is a Lottie animation, not a model.

features.name: SMS phishing/spam blocking (legacy on-device engine, assets/model)
pipeline: Incoming SMS handled by the antispam policy chain (com.miui.antispam) -> SmartSmsFilterPolicy.handleData (skips international builds; requires service_sms_mode/stranger_sms_mode)
shouldFilter: skip empty body, MIUI notification template (isMiuiPattern), YellowPage antispam white list; else j2.a.h(number, body)
j2.a.h builds the new engine (d9.a.b from files/SmsEngineResource) and only falls back to the legacy engine when MIUI MMS versionCode < 11000249
ah.a.a builds ah.b(number, body): strip +86, category = dh.a.d(number) (8 classes), body normalised by ah.h.c
new dh.e().e(b): dh.j/dh.b/dh.c split the body and yield 9 rule feature counts (b.m); the split pieces are stored in b.l
ah.d.h: applies ah.e.f flags (URL heuristic ah.i.b, phish list ah.d.d) and ch.d pattern flags from assets/pattern, loads ah.g(assets/dict)
dh.e.f(b) -> a(b): the split pieces are expanded with the ah.g dictionary (assets/dict) and filtered by ah.i.a/ah.g.c; the sorted set becomes b.i(), the token list matched against the model
opens assets/model through ah.c.b(Context,"model") (files/model override wins if present), reads 5 stages with DataInputStream (big-endian)
per stage: s[k] = sum(feature ? w[k][f] : log1p(-exp(w[k][f]))) + token/pattern terms + category bias; d = s0 - s1; thresholds decide class or defer to next stage; majority vote
result 1 => block reason 8 (phishing), 2 => block reason 4 (spam); a 'Common' sender with existing SMS/call history is unblocked via ah.f.a
features.notes: Container fully decoded (ir/parse_model.py); walk consumes all 680,154 bytes. Weights are log-probabilities (ah.i.g(x)=log(1-exp(x)); all weights negative). Spam-probe vs ham-probe tokens separate at +136.8 / -131.4 log-odds against thresholds 10.1 / -9.6. Patch: the in-APK entry is the exported ContentProvider (AntiSpamProvider case 9), not AntiSpamService; PDU->text happens in the caller SMS app. Policy dispatch is d2.b.e -> SmartSmsFilterPolicy (priority 18) -> j2.a.h. Block action = block type 4/8 returned to the caller + async FirewallLog insert (o2.f.a).

features.name: SMS filtering (new TFLite engine, downloaded resources)
entrypoints: d2.b.e (PolicyManager SMS chain) and j2.a.h gate the new engine; d9.a is released after every message
pipeline: j2.a.h -> d9.a.b(files/SmsEngineResource) constructs c9.a(v.txt), a9.a(2.bin), a9.c(1.bin), a9.b
d9.a.c(addr, body): z8.a regex gate, a9.b phone/content model, then a9.a on the c9.a vector -> 'important SMS' (return 0)
d9.a.d(body): z8.a regex filters, c9.a -> float[1][128], a9.a gate (return not-spam if important), a9.c -> 'unlaw' spam verdict
both TFLite interpreters are org.tensorflow.lite.b (Interpreter) over NativeInterpreterWrapperExperimental with default (null) options => CPU kernels, no NNAPI, no Flex
features.notes: Code path confirmed; the model files themselves are delivered by resource.zip from https://api.sec.intl.miui.com/GuardProviderV1/GetResourceZipFile and are absent from the APK, so their graphs are unknown.

features.name: Performance mode 'AI model' asset (not a model)
pipeline: a8.r0 loads assets/redmi_performance_mode/Ai-Model.json together with redmi_performance_mode/images for the performance-mode UI
features.notes: File content is a Lottie animation ({"v":"5.8.1","fr":60,...,"nm":"lottie"}), 119,414 B; it is an animation payload, not a neural network.

models.format: custom big-endian cascade of 5 log-linear (log-probability) SMS classifiers; u32 version=1, u32 0, u32 n_models=5, then per stage: i32 n_feat, dh.i char dictionary (i32 count + u16 chars), i32 length threshold, interleaved f64[2][n_feat] weights, i32 n_tokens + (u16 chars terminated by 0x000A, f64 w0, f64 w1)*, i32 n_patterns + same records, interleaved f64 cat_bias[2][8], f64 thr[3]

io.input: normalised SMS text (ah.h.c) + sender number (dh.a.d -> 8 categories) + 9 rule feature counts + per-stage character-presence vector + length flag; token hits by exact string match, pattern hits by substring contains
io.output: class decision 0/1 per stage (2-class log-odds difference d = s0 - s1 compared with thresholds), majority vote across stages

models.verification: ir/parse_model.py consumes all 680,154 bytes with zero remainder; reimpl/model.py runs under python3.12+JAX with the extracted float64 weights and matches an independent NumPy transcription of ah/d.java within 1e-9 on every stage; spam-token probe scores +136.83 (spam) and ham-token probe -131.43 (not spam) against thresholds 10.100 / -9.611. Log: reimpl/verify.txt (exit 0).

reimplementation.limitations: Weights are the real extracted values, but verification is against an independent NumPy transcription of the decompiled Java (ah/d.java, ah/i.java, ah/e.java), not against a running Android runtime. The 9 rule features (dh.j, dh.b, dh.c) are accepted as caller-supplied booleans instead of being re-derived from the raw SMS, and the ch.d pattern-feedback counters are inputs. The newer TFLite engine (1.bin/2.bin/v.txt) cannot be rebuilt because its files are downloaded at runtime and absent from the APK.

trigger.entry: ContentResolver.query(content://antispam/sms_judge, selectionArgs={address,body,simId}) -> com.miui.antispam.db.AntiSpamProvider.query case 9 (also update case 9) -> c(String[]) -> new j2.c(...) -> d2.b.e(j2.c)
gates: o2.f.E(ctx)  (non-international, else default smsto: app must be com.android.mms)
trigger.pdu_decoding: outside APK (system SMS app); no SmsReceiver defined in this APK; 'sms_judge' string only in AntiSpamProvider.<clinit>
trigger.thread: Binder thread of the provider process (:remote); Binder.clearCallingIdentity() around judging

intermediate_objects: ah.b{number, category 0..7, normalised body, pieces, int[] features, List<String> tokens, Set<String> tokenSet, int flags}

preprocess: j2.c.<init>: o2.f.p(number) then o2.f.I() -> PhoneNumberUtils.PhoneNumber.parse(...).getNormalizedNumber(false,true); CountryCode.getNetworkCountryCode(); Brazil(62) leading '0' toggle

ah.b.<init>: strip '+86' when len>3 and prefix; dh.a.d(number) -> sender category index 0..7; ah.h.c(body) trim + split on , . ; : ! ，。；、：！ + de-obfuscation of separator-laced pieces (>=3 weird chars, >=50% density)
dh.e.e: pieces list (whole body then dh.j/dh.b/dh.c splits); 9 rule features int[9] (dh.j=1, dh.b=1, dh.c=7)
dh.e.f -> a(): expand pieces with assets/dict segmenter (ah.g.a -> bh.a.c); keep all-CJK (ah.i.a) or in-dictionary (ah.g.c); TreeSet sort/dedup -> token list
dh.e.f: feature vector int[9 rules] ++ char-dict occurrence counts (dh.i.b) ++ [len(body)>=n_chars2] (dh.h.b); 9+n_chars+1 == n_feat for all stages
ah.e.f: URL heuristic ah.i.b -> flag bit1; phish list ah.d.d -> bit2; ch.d.e(assets/pattern) -> pattern bits; ah.e.g shifts thresholds by ((active-inactive)*(thr0-thr1))/4

model.engine: pure Java evaluator ah.d.h(ah.b,Context); no tensor runtime

supporting_assets.role: word segmenter, 348982 words; freshly parsed per message (ah.d.k -> ah.g.d), then discarded
absent from APK; ah.d.d would read it

postprocess: per stage: s[k]=sum(f>0?w[k][f]:log1p(-exp(w[k][f]))) + token terms + pattern terms + cat_bias[k][senderCat]; d=s0-s1; d<thr'[1] -> 0; d>thr'[0] -> 1; else vote=d-thr'[2]
after 5 stages: majority of positive votes; tie -> sum(vote)<0 ? 0 : 1
ah.a.a returns 2 (blocked) / 1 (blocked and flag bit2 = phish) / 0 (allow); history whitelist ah.f.a can unblock category 'Common'
consumer: AntiSpamProvider returns MatrixCursor{'smsBlockType'} to the caller SMS app
action: o2.f.a(ctx,number,blockType,keyword) when ExtraTelephony.getRealBlockType(type)>=3: async insert/update ExtraTelephony.FirewallLog.CONTENT_URI {number, read=1, type=2, reason, data1}
caller (outside APK) quarantines the message in the blocked conversation
failure_fallback: asset open failure -> ah.c.b returns null -> exception -> j2.a.h catches -> 0 (allow)
unknowns: caller SMS app code that decodes the PDU and issues the query
literal value of the com.google.android.exoplayer2.C.BUFFER_FLAG_FIRST_SAMPLE early-exit bit (constant name only)

preprocess: c9.a.a(body): strip \n \r \t, spaces, \s+, double/single quotes; lowercase; String.getBytes() (UTF-8); split by UTF-8 lead byte (>=0xFC:6, >=0xF8:5, >=0xF0:4, >=0xE0:3, >=0xC0:2, else 1)
map each code-point token via v.txt ('<token>\t<float>'), appended in message order to successive slots; unknown tokens dropped (no placeholder); zero-fill to 128
a9.b/b9.b: 7 hard-coded Pattern rules keyed by sender '10086', '95555' and fallback '0' (StatManager.PARAMS_SWITCH_OFF inlined as "0")

postprocess: d9.a.c: return true if sender-rule match or important; j2.a.h -> 0
d9.a.d: reject empty / pure number / 1-500 alnum-no-space; if important -> false; else unlaw
action: same block-type path as P1 (4/8) and FirewallLog insert
